author: Mrs Charlotta

title: Scammers
body: Was very confused about the trial and went to look in my Apple account subscriptions page. Nothing there…Within a couple of days they pulled over $120 USD from my PayPal account and are not responding to any of my emails.
author: Meline C. D.

title: It is a scam!
body: Confusing app and hard to cancel subscription. Free trial also subscribes you to the Fabulous app without telling you so you have to make sure you cancel that one as well. Pure evil.
author: Djoseph

title: Cancelled 25/9, billed 3/10
body:
Beware of free trial. I cancelled 25/9, but got billed 3/10. Support only sends the same message when confronted:

“Although we truly understand your situation and frustration, I'm sorry to say that unfortunately we won't be able to proceed with a refund for your purchase. As previously mentioned, the renewal date was displayed at the time of signing up and it was stated that the subscription automatically renews on an ongoing basis unless cancelled prior to the renewal date.

This refund request will now be closed, but please do let us know if you need assistance with anything else.”
author: Bästpåattmåla

title: A bit of light in the dark
body: A very beautiful and warming experience 😊
author: Nuthaella

title: Messy, stupid and vulgar
body: I very rarely let myself be lured into apps, but this one convinced me to try. But, a week into it, I feel increasingly annoyed by the tone, design, the all but adhd-friendly layout. Mumbo jumbo in a vulgar setting.
